zh: 双减政策实施后，孩子们的周末终于有了自由时间。
en: Since the double reduction policy took effect, children finally have free weekends again.

zh: 职业教育毕业生动手能力强，企业抢着要人。
en: Vocational graduates have strong hands-on skills, and companies are eager to hire them.

zh: 越来越多的中国学生选择去欧洲读研究生。
en: More and more Chinese students are choosing Europe for graduate school.

zh: 线上课程让偏远山区的孩子也能听到名师授课。
en: Online courses bring great teachers to children in remote mountain villages.

zh: 这位五十岁的阿姨坚持学英语，如今能给外国游客指路了。
en: The fifty-year-old lady kept learning English and can now give directions to foreign tourists.

zh: 学校把编程课纳入必修，培养孩子的逻辑思维。
en: The school made programming a required course to build children's logical thinking.

zh: 课后服务丰富多样，足球、书法和机器人社团最受欢迎。
en: After-school programs are rich and varied; football, calligraphy, and robotics clubs are the most popular.

zh: 教育公平是社会公平的重要基石。
en: Equal access to education is the foundation of social fairness.

zh: 今年高考报名人数再创新高，考生迎来人生大考。
en: A record number of students sat the college entrance exam this year.

zh: 研究生扩招缓解了就业压力，也带来了学历竞争。
en: Graduate school expansion has eased job pressure but also fueled credential competition.

zh: 留学归国人数逐年上升，许多人在科创企业找到了舞台。
en: The number of returning students rises every year, and many join tech startups.

zh: 老年大学的摄影课每学期都是最先报满的。
en: The photography class at the university for seniors fills up first every term.

zh: 阅读习惯要从小培养，亲子共读是最简单有效的方式。
en: Reading habits start early, and shared parent-child reading is the simplest way.

zh: 乡村教师通过远程培训更新了教学方法。
en: Rural teachers refreshed their teaching methods through online training.

zh: 职业技能大赛的获奖者不仅有奖金，还能破格晋升。
en: Winners of vocational skills contests get prize money and fast-tracked promotion.

zh: 双语幼儿园的学费不便宜，但报名的家庭依然排着队。
en: Bilingual kindergarten tuition is steep, yet families still line up to enroll.

zh: 大学与工厂合作开设订单班，学生一毕业就入职。
en: The university and a factory run targeted training classes; students go straight into jobs.

zh: 终身学习已经成为这个时代的必修课。
en: Lifelong learning has become a must in our times.

zh: 那位考上研究生的外卖小哥，激励了很多普通人。
en: The delivery rider who got into graduate school inspired countless people.

zh: 减负不是简单少留作业，而是把时间还给成长。
en: Easing homework burdens isn't just less homework; it means giving time back to growing up.
